1	import unittest
2	from store import Store
3	from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection
4	from cleanup import cleanup_setup
5	
6	
7	class SetupTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_completed_setup_is_visible(self):
9	        store = Store()
10	        begin_setup(store, "w", "one")
11	        complete_setup(store, "w", "one", "connection-one")
12	        self.assertEqual(active_connection(store, "w"), "connection-one")
13	
14	    def test_cleanup_removes_its_own_association(self):
15	        store = Store()
16	        begin_setup(store, "w", "one")
17	        complete_setup(store, "w", "one", "connection-one")
18	        cleanup_setup(store, "w", "one")
19	        self.assertIsNone(active_connection(store, "w"))
20	        self.assertNotIn("one", store.pending)
